title: Toro Built for the Trenches: Cigarroa's Carlos Aburto Powered a Historic Season
excerpt: Cigarroa senior Carlos Aburto powered the Toros' historic season — 168.9 rushing yards a game and nine touchdowns — as Cigarroa ended a 32-game losing streak and reached the playoffs for the first time in 20 years, KGNS reported.
content:
Cigarroa senior Carlos Aburto gave it his all for one final run at the playoffs, and the Toros’ fullback delivered a historic season for South Laredo, KGNS reported Nov. 25 in its season lookback, “Toro built for The Trenches.”

Aburto, a senior running back listed at 5 feet 9 inches, led the Toros in rushing at 168.9 yards per game and scored nine touchdowns, all on the ground, according to MaxPreps.

The season was a turnaround. Cigarroa entered the year on a 32-game losing streak, but under new head coach Lawrence Ellison the Toros won five games and earned their first playoff berth in 20 years.

In the regular-season finale against Roma, Aburto ran for 165 yards. Israel Gonzalez scored on a 21-yard keeper and Rudy Huerta sealed the win with an interception, sending the Toros to the playoffs.

In the bi-district playoff Nov. 13 against Ray, Aburto scored the touchdown that put Cigarroa ahead 7-0. The Toros fell 42-14, according to KGNS.

Earlier in the season, the Laredo Morning Times spotlighted Aburto after a 28-14 win over Juarez-Lincoln, in which he ran 31 times for 172 yards and two touchdowns.

Sources: KGNS — “Toro built for The Trenches”, Nov. 25, 2026; MaxPreps — Cigarroa Toros football stats, https://www.maxpreps.com/tx/laredo/cigarroa-toros/football/stats/; TexasHSFootball — “Week 11 5A Team of the Week: Laredo Cigarroa Toros”, https://texashsfootball.com/week-11-5a-team-of-the-week-laredo-cigarroa-toros/; KGNS — “Toros Score Early but Can’t Keep Up”, Nov. 13, 2026
